data.headline: Global Practice Head - Cloud Product & Platform Engineering at Wipro Limited
data.about: Innovative technology executive, entrepreneur, and founder with 30+ years of experience building successful technology ventures from the ground up. I specialize in leading large-scale cloud and AI/ML transformations, delivering enterprise-grade SaaS, big data, and blockchain platforms that scale globally.Throughout my career, I have co-founded multiple technology businesses and built high-impact products used by Fortune 500 enterprises. My deep technical solutions have been widely adopted across highly regulated industries, including healthcare, finance, security, and energy.By bridging the gap between deep technical architecture and high-velocity business growth, I have a proven track record of scaling global engineering organizations and winning large-scale enterprise transformation deals.

description.text:
Enable technology-driven enterprises to build / modernize multi-cloud, multi-tenant, as-a-Service products & platforms.

Partner with global sales teams to architect technical solutions, winning $5M–$60M engineering transformation and platform modernization deals. Own technical practice offerings, thought leadership, and solution architectures while directing a global organization of cloud architects, engineers, and Engineering Directors.

Key Achievements:

  - Multi-Sector IoT & Data Platforms: Designed and delivered high-scale, mission-critical SaaS and streaming platforms across regulated industries, including FinTech fraud detection, HIPAA-compliant MedTech devices (billions of daily messages), Energy AI/ML analytics, and Automotive connected fleets.

  - Enterprise Deal Architecture: Honored with multiple awards for structuring and winning high-value, transformative product engineering mega-deals.

  - GenAI Lifecycle Automation: Conceived, architected, and deployed a GenAI platform that accelerated the Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC), delivering a ~70% effort reduction across product definition, architecture, UX/UI, coding, DevOps, test engineering, and program planning.

  - AI & Cloud Blueprints: Authored the global Product Engineering Framework and architecture patterns for building scalable, multi-tenant, AI-infused cloud products.

description.text:
EquiFi is revolutionizing home financing with innovative and efficient equity-based instruments that transform how people purchase and leverage their homes. 

We have created a sustainable financing product for homebuyers and homeowners. Our Equity Funding Instrument (EFI) can be used to reduce the amount of debt used to buy a home, or to extract equity from a home. We co-invest with the homeowner and then manage pools of these fractional interest for investors seeking to invest in homes through a diversified fractional approach.

Responsible for delivering differentiated Big Data technology solutions and platforms for Enterprise Big Data Lake, BI & Analytics on Big Data, Machine Learning, Real Time Analytics, API, etc.

Responsible for product strategy, management and customer engagement for StreamAnalytix product. It is a visual platform to rapidly build & operationalize real-time analytics and machine learning use cases over multiple open source engines like Apache Spark, Storm, and Flink.

Grew Impetus from a startup to a multi-national, multi-company products and solutions group.

Established group's technology and product vision and led all aspects of product creation & engineering excellence. Built, grew and ran product & solution engineering teams for 100s of technology & enterprise customers. Created and managed multiple Centers of Excellence including Big Data, Data Science, UX, Mobile & Test Engineering. Built and nurtured Impetus R&D Labs to identify, track, and experiment with new and potentially disruptive technologies.   

Co-created and ran engineering of highly successful technology businesses:

1.	ClearTrail Technologies Pvt Ltd - Founded in 2001
ClearTrail provides products and solutions that deliver actionable intelligence from communication data to enable security agencies to prevent security threats and solve crimes. It serves government security agencies across APAC and Middle East region. 

2.	Intellicus Technologies Pvt Ltd - Founded in 2004
Intellicus is one of the world's leading Business Intelligence and Analytics platform. More than 60% of Fortune 500 companies are using Intellicus to build powerful reports and dashboards with ease.

3.	Kyvos Insights - Founded in 2014
Kyvos delivers BI on Hadoop at an unparalleled scale, granularity, and responsiveness unlike ever before. 

Kyvos provides a self-service interface to design OLAP cubes graphically on Hadoop for entities running into hundreds of millions, and browse using familiar BI tools like Tableau, Excel, Microstrategy, Cognos, and BusinessObjects, or Kyvos' native modern interface.

Established and expanded company's capability to provide outsourced product engineering services to technology companies in the USA. 

Built service parts logistics planning product and spun out a company Servigistics.

Created and successfully established products in Indian market namely, Q-Basic to C language Transpiler, and NewsServer: an automated news receiving & transmitting over teleprinter lines, filtering, printing, and mgmt.
